machine_routines_common.c: tests that interrupts are disabled before reading the current CPU interrupt-state pointer and returning whether it is non-null. The original tests DAIF and then follows TPIDR_EL1 to cpu_int_state.

The four arguments are saved. The factory allocates the descriptor, calls initWithPhysicalMask with kernel_task, derives contiguous options from the boolean, sets length to zero and calls appendBytes with the saved source and length. Matches IOBufferMemoryDescriptor.cpp and the arm64 IOKit export.

Direct nonvirtual getter between withPersistentMemoryDescriptor and copySharingContext. Loads the 32-bit _flags at object offset 0x20 and returns it zero extended to 64 bits. getDirection masks the field and getTag uses a later field and a virtual slot.
